## [1.2.0](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-09-29)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* equalizer takes res id (revert resolve), keep const-only edits ([7136f16](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/7136f16d4124a5f01a296672abde009cecf5fd61))

### ✨ New Features

* accent buttons + now-playing (lime stock, Monet dynamic) ([14f7ef3](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/14f7ef3ccde3810920137810b398396b7201b846))
* add Monet dynamic colors patch (M3 Expressive roles, API 31+) ([8e31a7a](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/8e31a7a14aa4eabd14118e95aeb66307af1b836c))
* enable all patches by default ([175f9a4](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/175f9a459ca380a77c9d7a3875418f8f7c7e510e))
* player day-mode round 2 (queue binds, pills, lotties, share) ([9d67829](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/9d6782964f80fc6056a37d73ef94f64f8bd76a72))
* player day-mode whites (play disc, seekbar paints, lottie tint experiment) ([fa95d79](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/fa95d79ea0b8fb808297ff5e1ffc889e7a313c65))
* player primary-accent theme (app_color), readable queue, accent-fill pills, lottie re-tint ([c3bf6a7](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/c3bf6a7f6235ea6613ce4f57fc2fa85c9ac4fd0e))
* player theme background patches (remove cover tint, day/night chrome) ([e30d5d3](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/e30d5d39af542cf109f225adb1348cd7a3b90aad))
* readable player queue in day mode, day-transparent scrims, feed header ([527b8bb](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/527b8bbbdeda6df7e330c276bb6e654ea689c2d2))
* round-4 light-mode fixes (lime accent, lottie attr, pill bg, lyrics) ([288fe3c](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/288fe3c0d772e22f54b75733d5b71bbc5ebd0ecb))

patches.name: Disable audio ads
patches.description: Forces AdSettings.noAd=true and PlayQueue.getDisableAds=true so songs are treated as ad-free locally. Client flag only.

patches.name: Hide Gold features
patches.description: Forces Account.isGold/isGoldUser and all GoldUtilsKt.isGold overloads to false. Hides server-gated Gold UI instead of spoofing it.

patches.name: Hide shuffle badges
patches.description: Hides PLAYS IN SHUFFLE badges on playlist/album headers, feed cards, and rows. Cosmetic only.

patches.name: Hide upgrade upsell
patches.description: Hides the nav upgrade entry, header promo banner, feed upsell cards and AI MIX button model (gap-free), and settings subscribe banner. Server-driven UI the Plus spoof cannot remove.

patches.name: Hide upsell feature buttons
patches.description: Hides TRY SING ALONG karaoke upsell, the player AI MIX switch, and the playlist AI MIX button. Feature gates untouched.

patches.name: Monet dynamic colors
patches.description: Replaces the static neon brand accents with wallpaper-based Monet dynamic colors (M3 Expressive primary/secondary/tertiary roles) on Android 12+. Older versions keep stock colors.

patches.name: Player theme background
patches.description: Makes the player background, text, icons and seekbar follow the app's day/night theme. Keeps the darker split below the progress bar. Pair with 'Player: remove cover-art tint'.

patches.name: Player: accent action icons
patches.description: Paints the share button with the normal theme text color (black day / white night) and keeps the like/download lotties on the primary accent (pink day / lime night, Monet dynamic) across animation swaps.

patches.name: Player: accent now-playing + pills
patches.description: Paints the now-playing queue row with the primary accent (pink day / lime night stock, Monet dynamic). Shuffle/enhance/save pills and unselected rows stay on theme text. Removes the grey highlight wash.

patches.name: Player: readable queue in day mode
patches.description: Keeps the player queue rows in theme text colors in day mode instead of unreadable white-on-light. Night mode is unchanged.

patches.name: Player: remove cover-art tint
patches.description: Stops the player background from being tinted by the current album cover, in both day and night mode.

patches.name: Remove popup promos
patches.description: No-ops the in-house popup funnel, the fullscreen startup dialog, and the flyer ad callback. Google SDK ads untouched.

patches.name: Spoof stock app signature
patches.description: Forces SignatureUtils.getAppSignature to hash with the stock cert prefix (he9B...kw=), so X-ANGH-APP-RGSIG matches a stock install. Salt/body hashing unchanged.

patches.name: Unforce shuffle
patches.description: No-ops PlayQueue.shuffle(), forces server shuffleOn=false at both sync points, disables the pick-a-song radio redirect, enables shuffle buttons, and disarms the shuffle upsell dialog. Manual shuffle toggle keeps working.

patches.name: Unlock downloads
patches.description: No-ops download limit asserts, forces limited-plan=false and large offline caps (999999). Local gates only; the server still authorizes files.

patches.name: Unlock local Plus
patches.description: Forces Account.isPlus/isPlusUser=true, enablePlayerRestrictions=false, canPlayOfflineAndFree=true. Local UI/gating only; server premium checks remain.

patches.name: Unlock playback limits
patches.description: Disables skip and queue limits (skipLimitReached/queueRestrictionsEnabled=false, disable-flags=true). Local gates only.
